text:
This looks like scrambled egg whites or a soft crumbled cheese on a square plate about 24 cm across. The pile covers roughly 13×12 cm and is moderately heaped, so I estimate about 150 g. If it is egg whites, it would come to around 100 kcal. If it is fresh cheese, it would be much higher, around 300–450 kcal. Scrambled egg whites seem the more likely match: the pieces look pale, soft and curd-like, though they could also be plain scrambled eggs. Plain scrambled eggs at about 150 kcal per 100 g would give roughly 225 kcal, so I've settled on a middle figure of about 200 kcal.

{"kcal": 200, "mass_g": 150}
